{{Quote|The White Terror did this to me. It's a wampa, but&hellip; so much more. Imagine a battleship next to a starfighter.|Kaiya Stas|<ref name="ICIF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|I Came, I Froze, I...|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>}}
The '''White Terror''' was the name given to a legendary [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] who stalked colonists on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
